content.title: The Best Viewing Spots Along the Rose Bowl Parade Route – A la Carte Tours
content.text: Each New Year’s Day, millions gather to watch the iconic Rose Bowl Parade in Pasadena, California. With breathtaking floats and lively performances, this event is a visual feast. To make the most of your experience, knowing where to watch is key. For those looking to enhance their experience, consider joining one of the Rose Bowl Parade tours, which offer guided access to some of the best viewing spots. Here are some prime locations along the parade route and tips for getting there. Colorado Boulevard Colorado Boulevard is the main street for the Rose Bowl Parade. This area is famous for its grand floats and lively crowds. Watching from here gives you a front-row view of the stunning floral displays. It’s also near many local restaurants and shops, making it easy to grab a bite before or after the parade. Arriving early is essential, as it can get crowded quickly. Many people set up their chairs overnight to secure the best spots. Orange Grove Boulevard For a different perspective, Orange Grove Boulevard is a fantastic choice. This street provides a more relaxed atmosphere while still offering great views of the floats. It’s less crowded than Colorado Boulevard, allowing for a more enjoyable experience. Arrive early to secure a good spot, and consider bringing blankets for comfort. The trees along this route provide pleasant shade. TV Corner The TV Corner, located at Colorado Boulevard and Rosemont Avenue, is lively and energetic. This is where many televised segments are filmed, making it a great spot for photos. However, it can get crowded, so be sure to arrive early to enjoy the action while feeling the event’s buzz. Pasadena City Hall Viewing the parade from Pasadena City Hall offers a unique backdrop. The building’s stunning architecture adds to the event’s beauty, and this area is usually less crowded. Bring a camera to capture the floats against this iconic structure. Arriving early in the morning will help you find the best viewing spots. Tips for Getting There Plan Your Arrival: Traffic can be heavy on New Year’s Day, so plan to arrive early. Most people start arriving before sunrise, so be prepared for a long wait. Public Transport: Using public transportation is highly recommended. The Metro Gold Line can take you close to the parade route. Parking can be challenging, so using transit can save you time and stress. Stay Hydrated and Comfortable: Bring water and snacks, as it can be a long day. Dress in layers, as the weather can change, and make sure to wear comfortable shoes. Consider Rose Bowl Parade Packages and Rose Bowl Parade Tours: These packages often include transportation, seating, and even meals. They make for a hassle-free experience so you can focus on enjoying the parade. Takeaway Messages Finding the best spots along the Rose Bowl Parade route makes your experience unforgettable. Whether you choose the bustling Colorado Boulevard or the serene Pasadena City Hall, each location offers a unique view of this spectacular event.
